name: Synthetic Art: Fire of the Flaming Mountain

sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Fire Release, Shin Branch

system.description:
In order to cast this jutsu, you must currently have your Synthetic Chakra Mode active and have a creature marked with your Shin Seal.

You draw your synthetic blood, calling to the fires of the flaming mountain to destroy your foes. Select a creature you can see marked with your Shin Seal, and dispel it. When you do, your seal grows, and opens a gate centered on them to the flames of fire mountain, creating a 20-foot radius, 120-foot-high eruption of hell fire, forcing all creatures in range to make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on success.

If an affected creature has ranks of Doused it is treated as if they have 5 ranks, even if they actually have less.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
